value.rationale: The family \(P_{p,q}\) is a canonical complete height-two finite model. The result is a complete structural classification of the Stong core after imposing the natural two-particle collision constraint, with a sharp level-size-two transition and explicit core formulas. For \(p,q\ge3\), it shows that every one of the \((p+q)(p+q-1)\) configurations is indispensable under beat-point reduction, a finite-homotopy fact not determined by known Betti numbers.
